title: ADV MANUFACTURING PROCESSES
description: Principles of nontraditional manufacturing, nontraditional transport and media. Emphasis on laser assisted materials processing, laser material interactions with applications to laser material removal, forming, and surface modification. Introduction to electrochemical machining, electrical discharge machining and abrasive water jet machining
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: Introductory course on manufacturing processes, and heat transfer, knowledge of engineering materials, or instructor’s permission.
raw_title_text: MECE E4610 ADV MANUFACTURING PROCESSES. 3.00 points .
